disorder-name.detail: Schizophrenia spectrum disorder across multiple illness stages. The Methods section describes participants as '601 individuals diagnosed with schizophrenia-spectrum disorder across multiple illness stages', though the paper title and some sections use 'schizophrenia' as shorthand.
disorder-name.supporting_text: "601 individuals diagnosed with schizophrenia-spectrum disorder across multiple illness stages (mean [SD] age, 31.46 [12.31] years; 380 [63.23%] male)"

dataset-of-origin.detail: Data collated from 13 different sites across multiple separate studies, harmonized retrospectively. Dataset identical to that used in Cetin-Karayumak et al. (2020). Philadelphia Neurodevelopmental Cohort (PNC) is explicitly named as one site (Ethics section); other site names are not listed in this paper.
dataset-of-origin.supporting_text: "dMRI data were collated from 13 different sites across a number of separate studies." / "All data, except for the Philadelphia Neurodevelopmental Cohort (PNC) (Satterthwaite et al., 2014, 2016) were provided by the principal investigators following procurement of Institutional Review Board approvals"
dataset-of-origin.location: Elad2021.pdf.md: Methods / 2.1 Participants, L62-L63; Ethics section, L243

age.detail: Mean and SD are directly reported for the schizophrenia-spectrum disorder group. Min and max age are not reported for the clinical cohort.
age.supporting_text: "601 individuals diagnosed with schizophrenia-spectrum disorder across multiple illness stages (mean [SD] age, 31.46 [12.31] years; 380 [63.23%] male)"

sex.detail: Male N and % directly reported (380, 63.23%). Female N estimated as 601 - 380 = 221; female % = 36.77% ≈ 36.8%. Female N is confirmed by Discussion section which states '233:221 in females' (controls:SCZ).
sex.supporting_text: "601 individuals diagnosed with schizophrenia-spectrum disorder across multiple illness stages (mean [SD] age, 31.46 [12.31] years; 380 [63.23%] male)" / "different proportions of subjects belonging to the control group versus subjects belonging to the schizophrenia group (279:380 in males, 233:221 in females)"
